The JW Comics Universe

Every Legend Starts Somewhere. Ours Started on the Page.

Across original Chronicles, intergalactic adventures, ancient mythologies, Philadelphia heroes, and experimental science, characters and civilizations cross paths in a universe built through years of storytelling.

Read it. Hear it. Watch it. Wear it. Stories, soundtracks, animation, films, and collectible artwork all have a place in the Jungle Star universe.

Independent Comics · Animation · Soundtracks · Motion Pictures

THE NOTEBOOK ESCAPED.

Seventeen years of original characters, cosmic battles, superheroes, villains, and entire civilizations—and the founder is still finding new ways to bring them to life.

Writer, comic-book creator, illustrator, musician, producer, animator, video editor, website developer, and construction crew. Even the printing department had to be built from scratch.

Most creators dream of seeing their comics printed. Our founder bought the printing equipment, learned the production process, and became his own publishing department. At this point, the only employee who hasn't requested a vacation is the printer—and even that machine occasionally goes on strike!

The stories are written. The universes are built. The next mission is bringing them to screens, speakers, bookshelves, and audiences around the world.
